semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-purity glassware and consumables for ultrapure wet electronic chemicals used in semiconductor processes.
summary: Nanjing Binzhenghong Instrument Co., Ltd. produces high-purity glassware and consumables essential for the packaging, storing, and transferring of ultrapure wet electronic chemicals in the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include PFA sample vials, volumetric flasks, and various filtration equipment, catering to the needs of semiconductor manufacturing and chemical production.
capabilities: High-purity PFA sample vials and volumetric flasks
PFA filter columns for chromatographic applications
Fluoride distillation apparatus for chemical production
PTFE filter membrane clips for chemical filtration
